title: OKROBO Competition Definition v1
description: A self-contained challenge: an arena (embedded, field-for-field identical to contracts/world/v1) plus a list of objectives a student's own robot program is scored against while it runs. This document carries no simulation behavior of its own -- scoring is computed entirely in apps/studio/src/compete/score.ts from the robot's own already-exposed per-tick pose, never inside the student-facing API or the engine. Units: meters, radians, seconds -- same as contracts/world/v1.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case (matches contracts/pack/v0's own id convention).

robot.description: Which robot kind this competition targets. Only 'car' exists in v0 -- an explicit enum (not assumed) so 'arm'/'drone' can be added later with no version fork.

arena.description: Embedded, not referenced: nothing in the pack system today lets one content file reference another, and a competition should be one portable document a student can share on its own. Field-for-field identical to contracts/world/v1/schema.json.

objectives.description: Independent in v1 unless a reach_zone opts into ordering via its own `sequence` field (new in v1 -- see docs/decisions/competition-arena-definition-scoring.md). Every objective is still evaluated every tick; a sequenced reach_zone simply can't be achieved yet while a lower-sequence reach_zone is still outstanding.

oneOf.description: Awarded once, the first time the robot's own position enters this circle AND (if `sequence` is set) every other reach_zone objective with a strictly lower `sequence` has already been achieved. Staying inside, or re-entering, never re-awards it.

sequence.description: New in v1. Omitted means always immediately reachable (v0's own behavior, unchanged). When set, this zone can only be achieved once every other reach_zone objective with a strictly lower sequence value has been achieved; equal values form a concurrently-reachable tier.

label.description: New in v1. Shown in the HUD/report instead of the generic "Reach the zone" wording when present (e.g. "Pickup zone").

oneOf.description: Deducts penalty_per_hit each time the robot's own circle (radius = arena.robot_radius) starts overlapping an obstacle box it wasn't already overlapping -- edge-triggered per obstacle, so one continuous overlap costs one penalty, not one per tick.
At most one per competition (enforced by the hand-written validator, not expressible here). Ends the run once elapsed time reaches this many seconds.
